entities.name: RlmN
observations: The 372-residue query protein matches reviewed RlmN homologs at 61.7–64.6% identity with 95.7–97.6% query coverage and E-values of 1.7e-158 to 1.9e-163.
Pfam matches include RlmN_N (PF21016) at residues 9–66 and Radical_SAM (PF04055) at residues 112–283.
RlmN is a dual-specificity RNA methyltransferase that methylates adenine C2 in 23S rRNA A2503 and tRNA A37.
The enzyme binds one [4Fe-4S] cluster coordinated by three cysteines and uses S-adenosyl-L-methionine (SAM).
Sequence-derived properties: 372 aa, estimated molecular mass 41.84 kDa, theoretical pI 8.87, and positive charge at pH 7.
The assignment is supported primarily by homology and domain evidence; exact substrate preference is inferred from close curated homologs rather than experimentally tested for this query.

source_tools.relevance: Sequence analysis, Pfam domains, homologs, function, cofactors, and reactions

entities.name: RlmN rRNA methylation
observations: Adenosine 2503 in 23S rRNA is converted to 2-methyladenosine 2503 using two SAM molecules and reduced electron donors; products include 5'-deoxyadenosine, methionine, S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine, and oxidized electron donors.
This radical-SAM methylation is associated with Rhea reaction records RHEA:42916 and related mappings.
The catalytic transformation is commonly summarized as rRNA-A2503 + SAM + reducing equivalents → rRNA-m2A2503 + 5'-deoxyadenosine + SAH, with the detailed stoichiometry involving two SAM molecules.

entities.name: RlmN tRNA methylation
observations: Adenosine 37 in tRNA is converted to 2-methyladenosine 37 using two SAM molecules and reduced electron donors; products include 5'-deoxyadenosine, methionine, S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine, and oxidized electron donors.
This radical-SAM methylation is associated with Rhea reaction records RHEA:43332 and related mappings.

entities.name: S-adenosyl-L-methionine
observations: SAM is the methyl donor and radical-SAM substrate for RlmN; the enzyme uses two SAM equivalents in the detailed net reaction representation.

entities.name: [4Fe-4S] cluster
observations: RlmN binds one [4Fe-4S] cluster coordinated by three cysteines; the cluster activates SAM cleavage in the radical-SAM mechanism.

source_tools.relevance: RlmN cofactor annotation and Radical_SAM domain evidence

entities.name: RNA base methylation
observations: RlmN participates in rRNA base methylation and tRNA methylation in the cytoplasm.
The 23S rRNA A2503 modification contributes to ribosomal proofreading, while tRNA A37 modification is associated with tRNA maturation/function.

source_tools.relevance: GO and curated functional annotations for RlmN homologs
